html.cannot_install_server: Cannot install the HTML language server: {e}
html.command_install: HTML: install the language server (npm vscode-langservers-extracted)
html.description: HTML and Pug: colors, errors (unclosed or misnested elements, duplicate ids), completion of elements, attributes, values and entities, documentation, structure, tag pairs, ids, classes and mixins, and formatting. The code of <script> and <style> (and the style and onclick attributes) is handled by JavaScript, TypeScript and CSS, with their colors, completion, errors and formatting. With the language server of VS Code for HTML, and by local analysis without it.
html.duplicate_id: The id “{id}” is already used in the page
html.element.a: A hyperlink to a page, a file, a place in the page or an address.
html.element.abbr: An abbreviation or acronym; its title gives the full form.
html.element.address: Contact information for its nearest article or the page.
html.element.area: A clickable area of an image map.
html.element.article: A self-contained composition: a post, a news story, a comment.
html.element.aside: Content indirectly related to the main content: a sidebar, a note.
html.element.audio: A sound or an audio stream, with controls if asked.
html.element.b: Text drawn to attention without extra importance (bold).
html.element.base: The base URL and target of all the relative links of the page.
html.element.bdi: Text isolated from the direction of the text around it.
html.element.bdo: Text drawn in the direction its dir attribute gives.
html.element.blockquote: A quotation from another source, as a block.
html.element.button: A clickable button: it submits a form or runs a script.
html.element.canvas: A drawing surface for scripts (2D, WebGL).
html.element.caption: The title of a table.
html.element.cite: The title of a creative work: a book, a film, a song.
html.element.col: A column of a table, for its attributes.
html.element.colgroup: A group of columns of a table.
html.element.datalist: Suggested values for an input (its list attribute).
html.element.dd: The description of a term in a description list.
html.element.details: A disclosure widget: its summary shows, the rest opens on demand.
html.element.dfn: The defining instance of a term.
html.element.dialog: A dialog box or window, modal or not.
html.element.div: A generic block container, with no meaning of its own.
html.element.dl: A description list: terms (dt) and their descriptions (dd).
html.element.dt: A term in a description list.
html.element.embed: External content shown by a plugin or the browser.
html.element.fieldset: A group of controls of a form, with its legend.
html.element.figure: Self-contained content (image, diagram, code) with its caption.
html.element.footer: The footer of its section or of the page.
html.element.form: A form: controls whose values are sent to a server.
html.element.h1: A heading of level 1, the most important.
html.element.h6: A heading of level 6, the least important.
html.element.head: The metadata of the page: title, styles, scripts.
html.element.header: Introductory content: a logo, a title, a navigation.
html.element.html: The root of an HTML document.
html.element.i: Text in an alternate voice: a term, a foreign word (italic).
html.element.iframe: Another page embedded in this one.
html.element.input: A form control: text, number, date, checkbox, file…
html.element.label: The caption of a form control.
html.element.link: A link to an external resource: a style sheet, an icon, a preload.
html.element.main: The main content of the page, once per page.
html.element.map: An image map, with its areas.
html.element.mark: Text marked or highlighted for reference.
html.element.menu: A list of commands, as an unordered list.
html.element.meta: Metadata: the encoding, the viewport, a description.
html.element.meter: A value within a known range: a disk usage, a score.
html.element.noscript: Content shown when scripts are off.
html.element.object: An external resource: an image, a page, a plugin.
html.element.optgroup: A group of options in a select.
html.element.option: An option of a select or a datalist.
html.element.output: The result of a calculation or of an action.
html.element.picture: Several sources of an image, for the browser to choose from.
html.element.rp: Parentheses shown around a ruby annotation when ruby is not supported.
html.element.rt: The text of a ruby annotation (pronunciation).
html.element.ruby: Text with ruby annotations, for East Asian scripts.
html.element.s: Text that is no longer accurate (struck through).
html.element.script: A script: JavaScript code, or a module, or data.
html.element.search: The controls that search or filter.
html.element.section: A thematic section of the page, usually with a heading.
html.element.slot: A placeholder in a web component that its user fills.
html.element.source: A source of a picture, an audio or a video.
html.element.span: A generic inline container, with no meaning of its own.
html.element.style: A style sheet for the page.
html.element.summary: The visible heading of a details element.
html.element.svg: A vector image drawn in SVG.
html.element.table: A table of data, in rows and columns.
html.element.tbody: The body rows of a table.
html.element.td: A data cell of a table.
html.element.template: HTML that is not shown, for scripts to copy.
html.element.tfoot: The footer rows of a table.
html.element.th: A header cell of a table.
html.element.thead: The header rows of a table.
html.element.time: A date or a time, with a machine-readable value.
html.element.title: The title of the page, shown in the tab of the browser.
html.element.track: Timed text of a video or an audio: subtitles, captions.
html.element.var: A variable in a mathematical expression or in code.
html.element.video: A video, with controls if asked.
html.element.wbr: A place where the line may break.
html.image_without_alt: Image without an “alt” attribute: screen readers cannot describe it
html.needs_server: This action needs the HTML language server: install it from Search Everywhere (“HTML: install”)
html.pug_mixed_indentation: Tabs and spaces mixed in the indentation
html.pug_no_server: Pug has no language server: the IDE analyzes it by itself
html.pug_unclosed_attributes: The parenthesis of the attributes is not closed
